tulsi_vp.125.m: My heart is your house, Lord, and many thieves have come and settled in it. Tulsidas says: listen, Ram, thieves are looting your home; my great worry is only that it will give you a bad name.
roles: The house is handed back to its owner.
tulsi_vp.125.sa: मम हृदय भवन प्रभु तोरा।तहँ बसे आइ बहु चोरा॥ … कह तुलसिदास सुनु रामा।लूटहिं तसकर तव धामा॥ ८॥ चिंता यह मोहिं अपारा। अपजस नहिं होइ तुम्हारा॥

tulsi_vp.128.m: Will you ever place that lotus hand on my head, Raghunayak, the hand that made the distressed fearless when they once called your name helplessly? The cool, comforting shade of that hand removes wrongdoing, pain and illusion; day and night Tulsidas longs for the shade of that lotus hand.
roles: Shows he waits for the touch that gives fearlessness.
tulsi_vp.128.sa: कबहुँ सो कर-सरोज रघुनायक ! धरिहौ नाथ सीस मेरे। जेहि कर अभय किये जन आरत, बारक बिबस नाम टेरे॥ … सीतल सुखद छाँह जेहि करकी, मेटति पाप, ताप, माया। निसि-बासर तेहि कर सरोजकी, चाहत तुलसिदास छाया॥

tulsi_vp.137.m: If the kind Raghupati's grace is with you, what can anyone's enmity achieve? Not a hair of the devotee is bent, though someone tries a million schemes.
tulsi_vp.137.sa: जो पै कृपा रघुपति कृपालुकी, बैर औरके कहा सरै। होइ न बाँको बार भगतको, जो कोउ कोटि उपाय करे॥

tulsi_vp.144.m: Who is there that Raghubir did not keep safe, for the honour of his name? The compassionate one, for no reason at all, takes away the whole crowd of fears.
roles: Names compassion that needs no cause.
tulsi_vp.144.sa: सो धौ को जो नाम-लाज तें, नहिं राख्यो रघुबीर। कारुनीक बिनु कारन ही हरि हरी सकल भव-भीर॥

tulsi_vp.150.m: Ramabhadra, I worry about myself, and I don't. Every soul in the world is a vessel of suffering. On one side is my bond with the great and mighty one, and on the other, I: you have many like me, but I have only you.
tulsi_vp.150.sa: रामभद्र! मोहिं आपनो सोच है अरु नाहीं। जीव सकल संतापके भाजन जग माहीं॥ १॥ नातो बड़े समर्थ सों इक ओर किधौं हूँ तोको मोसे अति घने मोको एकै तूँ॥

tulsi_vp.160.m: Hari, I have heard you are the one who lifts the fallen. I am fallen and you lift the fallen: the two of us are a perfect match.
roles: Shows him resting his case on the Lord's name as patit pavan.
tulsi_vp.160.sa: मैं हरि पतित-पावन सुने। मैं पतित तुम पतित-पावन दोउ बानक बने॥

tulsi_vp.162.m: Who in the world is so generous? There is none like Ram, who melts for the suffering without any service done.
roles: Shows wonder at being cared for unearned.
tulsi_vp.162.sa: ऐसो को उदार जग माहीं। बिनु सेवा जो द्रवै दीनपर राम सरिस कोउ नाहीं॥

tulsi_vp.165.m: Raghubar, this is your greatness: passing over the rich, you honour the poor and show them more kindness. In this court the poor are respected; that has always been the custom here.
roles: This has always been the custom of his court.
tulsi_vp.165.sa: रघुबर! रावरि यहै बड़ाई। निदरि गनी आदर गरीबपर, करत कृपा अधिकाई॥ … यहि दरबार दीनको आदर, रीति सदा चलि आई

tulsi_vp.166.m: Such is Ram, the well-wisher of the lowly: utterly tender, a treasury of compassion, doing good to others without any reason.
tulsi_vp.166.sa: ऐसे राम-दीन हितकारी । अतिकोमल करुनानिधान बिनु कारन पर-उपकारी॥

tulsi_vp.167.m: Devotion to Raghupati is hard to practise. It is easy to talk about, but the doing is endless; only the one in whom it has taken root knows.
roles: Honesty about difficulty from a master of the path.
tulsi_vp.167.sa: रघुपति-भगति करत कठिनाई । कहत सुगम करनी अपार जानै सोइ जेहि बनि आई॥

tulsi_vp.172.m: Will I ever live like this? By the grace of kind Raghunath, will I take on the nature of a saint: always content with what comes, wanting nothing from anyone, always devoted to others' good, keeping my vow in mind, deed and word; hearing very harsh words and not burning in that fire; free of pride, even and cool of mind, speaking of others' virtues and not their faults; letting go of the body's worries, bearing joy and sorrow with an even mind?
roles: Shows bearing joy and sorrow with an even mind.
tulsi_vp.172.sa: कबहुँक हौं यहि रहनि रहौंगो। श्रीरघुनाथ-कृपालु-कृपातें संत-सुभाव गहौंगो॥ ९॥ जथालाभसंतोष सदा, काहू सों कछु न चहांगो। पर-हित-निरत निरंतर, मन क्रम बचन नेम निबहौंगो॥ … परुष बचन अति दुसह श्रवन सुनि तेहि पावक न दहांगो। बिगत मान, सम सीतल मन, पर-गुन नहिं दोष कहाँगो॥ ३॥ परिहरि देह-जनित चिंता, दुख-सुख समबुद्धि सहोंगो।

tulsi_vp.177.m: Even if you leave me, Ram, I will not leave you; leaving your feet, whom would I love? I am a poor beggar and you the good giver; I am a bad son, and you my loving father and mother.
tulsi_vp.177.sa: जो तुम त्यागों राम हौं तौ नहिं त्यागो । परिहरि पाँय काहि अनुरागों॥ … हौं तो कुजाचक, स्वामी सुदाता । हौं कुपूत, तुम हितु पितु-माता॥

tulsi_vp.179.m: Where do I go, whom do I tell, who will listen to someone so low? In all three worlds you alone are the way for the one who has lost every support. The world is full of would-be lords in every house, but your goodness is the support of those who have none.
roles: Cultivates Ram's virtues as the prop of those with none.
tulsi_vp.179.sa: कहाँ जाउँ, कासों कहौं, कौन सुने दीनकी। त्रिभुवन तुही गति सब अंगहीनकी॥ जग जगदीस घर धरनि घनेरे हैं। निराधारके अधार गुनगन तेरे हैं॥

tulsi_vp.181.m: Somehow, ocean of kindness, look my way; I have no other place, my one firm support is you. Like Sugriva terrified of mighty Bali, I am terrified of my karma; lord of the helpless, I want to live in the shelter of your arm.
roles: Shows he asks only to be looked at and sheltered.
tulsi_vp.181.sa: केहू भाँति कृपासिंधु मेरी ओर हेरिये। मोको और ठौर न, सुटेक एक तेरिये॥ … करम-कपीस बालि-बली, त्रास-त्रस्यो हौं। चाहत अनाथ-नाथ! तेरी बाह बस्यो हौं॥

tulsi_vp.182.m: Father, I give myself to you: you find the way. By your glance alone a losing throw becomes a winning one; by your showing, what cannot be seen is seen; by your explaining, what cannot be understood is understood.
tulsi_vp.182.sa: बाप! बलि जाउँ, आप करिये उपाउ सो। तेरे ही निहारे परै हारेहू सुदाउ सो॥४॥ तेरे ही सुझाये सूझै असुझ सुझाउ सो। तेरे ही बुझाये बूझै अबुझ बुझाउ सो॥

tulsi_vp.183.m: Ram, you know the ways of love well. The Vedas praise you as the one who takes away the bigness of the big and the smallness of the small.
tulsi_vp.183.sa: राम! प्रीतिकी रीति आप नीके जनियत है। बड़ेकी बड़ाई, छोटेकी छोटाई दूरि करै, ऐसी बिरुदावली, बलि, बेद मनियत है॥

tulsi_vp.184.m: By repeating Ram's name, the burning of the heart goes away.
roles: Gives the burn eases with the name.

tulsi_vp.189.m: Walk on saying Ram, walk on saying Ram, walk on saying Ram, brother; otherwise you'll be caught in the forced labour of the world, and getting free is very hard. The road is hard, there are no provisions with me, I've forgotten the name of my village. Tulsidas says: take away the fear of the world now, be kind to me, Ram.
tulsi_vp.189.sa: राम कहत चलु, राम कहत चलु, राम कहत चलु भाई रे। नाहिं तौ भव-बेगारि महँ परिहै, छुटत अति कठिनाई रे॥ … मारग अगम, संग नहिं संबल, नाउँ गाउँकर भूला रे। तुलसिदास भव त्रास हरहु अब, होहु राम अनुकूला रे॥

tulsi_vp.191#2.m: However low or sinful a person, once they took the shelter of the name, he tied them into his cloth like a coin and never again tested whether it was true or false.
roles: Shows taking cover behind the name.
tulsi_vp.191#2.sa: कैसेउ पाँवर पातकी, जेहि लई नामकी ओट। गाँठी बाँध्यो दाम तो, परख्यो न फेरि खर-खोट॥

tulsi_vp.201.m: What is gained by getting a human body, if in body, word and mind, not even in a dream, one ever helps with someone else's work?
roles: Shows helping with someone else's work.
tulsi_vp.201.sa: लाभ कहा मानुष-तनु पाये। काय-बचन-मन सपनेहुँ कबहुँक घटत न काज पराये॥

tulsi_vp.217.m: If there were anyone else, why would I keep coming back, Lord, to cry my troubles to you? If you find me too distasteful, then hand me over to someone like yourself. How else could Tulsidas leave your feet?
roles: Shows him unable to leave the feet.
tulsi_vp.217.sa: जो पै दूसरो कोउ होइ। तौ हौं बारहि बार प्रभु कत दुख सुनावौं रोइ॥ … आपसे कहुँ सौंपिये मोहि जो पै अतिहि घिनात। दासतुलसी और बिधि क्यों चरन परिहरि जात॥

tulsi_vp.221.m: Lord, day and night this poor one watches the road your kindness will come by. Kind to the lowly, when will it be? I cannot tell.
tulsi_vp.221.sa: नाथ ! कृपाहीको पंथ चितवत दीन हौं दिनराति। होइ धौं केहि काल दीनदयालु ! जानि न जाति॥

tulsi_vp.226.m: Let whoever trusts something else trust it; for me, Ram's name is the wishing tree that bears good fruit in this age. Where a person's love and trust lie, there their work gets done. For me, those two syllables are mother and father, and I am a stubborn child who has dug in his heels.
roles: Shows a stubborn child holding to two syllables.
tulsi_vp.226.sa: भरोसो जाहि दूसरो सो करो। मोको तो रामको नाम कलपतरु कलि कल्यान फरो॥ … प्रीति-प्रतीति जहाँ जाकी, तहँ ताको काज सरो। मेरे तो माय-बाप दोउ आखर, हौं सिसु-अरनि अरो॥

tulsi_vp.227.m: Ram, your name alone is my well-wisher; I say it to all my companions in this life and the next, arms raised. Without the name I wandered, longing for something to fill my belly; even sorrow felt sorry when it looked at me. By the grace of the name, I who was a thorny babul now get mangoes.
roles: Names he credits the name for everything he has.
tulsi_vp.227.sa: नाम राम रावरोई हित मेरे। स्वारथ-परमारथ साथिन्ह सों भुज उठाइ कहाँ टेरे॥ … फिरयौ ललात बिनु नाम उदर लगि, दुखउ दुखित मोहि हेरे। नाम-प्रसाद लहत रसाल-फल अब हौं बबुर बहेरे॥

tulsi_vp.229.m: My tongue would rot if I called myself anyone else's. Life of Janaki, birth after birth in this world I have lived on your morsel. Tulsidas is always at peace on this strength: I belong to a great place.
roles: Names those whose bread he has eaten.
tulsi_vp.229.sa: गरैगी जीह जो कहौं औरको हौं। जानकी-जीवन! जनम-जनम जग ज्यायो तिहारेहि कौरको हों॥ … तुलसिदास सीतल नित यहि बल, बड़े ठेकाने ठौरको हौं॥

tulsi_vp.232.m: Where would I find another friend of the lowly? Who but you feels another's pain? To whom else would I tell my sorrow?
roles: Shows him taking his sorrow to the one who will feel it.
tulsi_vp.232.sa: दीनबन्धु दूसरो कहँ पावों ? को तुम बिनु पर-पीर पाइ है? केहि दीनता सुनावों॥

tulsi_vp.240.m: He alone is virtuous, pure and true with whom you, Ram, are pleased. The courtesan, the vulture and the hunter went to Hari's abode; when were they ever made perfect by Kashi or Prayag? Tulsi says: Ram is won by natural love; everything else is like oil on water.
tulsi_vp.240.sa: सोइ सुकृती, सुचि साँचो जाहि राम! तुम रीझे। गनिका, गीध, बधिक हरिपुर गये, लै कासी प्रयाग कब सीझे॥ … तुलसी सहज सनेह राम बस, और सबै जलकी चिकनाई॥

tulsi_vp.250.m: Having heard your ways, my trust and love are in you, yet I am afraid, seeing the cruelty of these times. It will only be well if you say it, or have it said, Ram: "Tulsi, you are mine. Do not lose heart, do not tremble."
roles: He asks only to be claimed.
tulsi_vp.250.sa: रीति सुनि रावरी प्रतीति-प्रीति रावरे सों, डरत हौं देखि कलिकालको कहरु। कहेही बनैगी कै कहाये, बलि जाउँ, राम, “तुलसी ! तू मेरो, हारि हिये न हहरु'॥

tulsi_vp.253.m: Ram, keep me in your shelter, as you have kept me every day till now. All three worlds know there has never been another so kind. Who but you protects the hurting who bow before him?
roles: Shows you have kept me all these days.
tulsi_vp.253.sa: राम ! राखिये सरन, राखि आये सब दिन। बिदित त्रिलोक तिहुँ काल न दयालु दूजो, आरत-प्रनत-पाल को है प्रभु बिन॥

tulsi_vp.254.m: Ram, your name is my mother and father, my kin and dear ones, my teacher and master, my companion and true friend. My steady love for your name is my unshakeable wealth.
tulsi_vp.254.sa: राम ! रावरो नाम मेरो मातु-पितु है। सुजन-सनेही, गुरु-साहिब, सखा-सुहृद, राम-नाम प्रेम-पन अबिचल बितु है॥

tulsi_vp.257.m: Friend of the poor, if you push the poor away they have no other refuge. Everyone is good to their own people, and someone somewhere is good to their own; but your feet, Ram, are good to everyone.
roles: Gives the one refuge that does not ask whose you are.
tulsi_vp.257.sa: दीनबंधु ! दूरि किये दीनको न दूसरी सरन। आपको भले हैं सब, आपनेको कोऊ कहूँ, सबको भलो है राम! रावरो चरन॥

tulsi_vp.261.m: What I try to make of myself would not come right in millions of ages; Ram, what you make comes right in a quarter of a moment.
tulsi_vp.261.sa: मेरी न बने बनाये मेरे कोटि कलप लौं राम! रावरे बनाये बने पल पाउ मैं।

tulsi_vp.266.m: The more I try to come near, kind one, the further away I fall. You are the same in all four ages, Ram; and I too am yours, though I am full of wrongs and faults.
tulsi_vp.266.sa: ज्यों ज्यों निकट भयो चहं कृपालु ! त्यों त्यों दूरि परयो हौं। तुम चहुँ जुग रस एक राम ! हौं हूँ राबरो, जदपि अघ अवगुननि भरो हौं॥

tulsi_vp.267.m: I have made a vow: from today I lie stubbornly at Ram's door. I will not get up my whole life until you say 'you are mine'; I swear by the Lord, I have lain down here.
roles: Shows a vow made with an oath.
tulsi_vp.267.sa: पन करि हौं हठि आजुतें रामद्वार परयो हौं। “तू मेरो' यह बिन कहे उठिहाँ न जनमभरि, प्रभुकी सौंकरि निरयो हौं॥

tulsi_vp.268.m: I'll know you have made me your own when my mind turns around: when, with the same ease with which it clung to pleasures, it loves the Lord without deceit. Hearing the Lord's qualities the mind will rejoice, tears will flow from the eyes; Tulsidas will trust Ram, and seeing that love, joy will well up and fill the heart.
roles: Joy and tears at hearing the Lord's virtues.
tulsi_vp.268.sa: तुम अपनायो तब जानिहौं, जब मन फिरि परिहै। जेहि सुभाव बिषयनि लग्यो, तेहि सहज नाथ सौं नेह छाडि छल करिंहै॥ … प्रभु-गुन सुनि मन हरषिहै, नीर नयननि ढरिहै। तुलसिदास भयो रामको बिस्वास, प्रेम लखि आनँद उमगि उर भरिहै॥

tulsi_vp.270.m: Raghubir, will you ever kindly look my way too? Treasury of mercy, knowing in your heart that good or bad I am your own, will you let my countless faults go?
roles: Shows good or bad, I am yours.
tulsi_vp.270.sa: कबहुँ कृपा करि रघुबीर! मोहू चितैहो। भलो-बुरो जन आपनो, जिय जानि दयानिधि ! अवगुन अमित बितैहो॥

tulsi_vp.271.m: Ram, whatever I am, I am your servant; do not cast me off. Ocean of mercy, lord of Kosala, protector of those who come for shelter, keep to your own nature. Even at fault, I am your own; do not forget Tulsi. A broken arm still hangs at your neck, and an injured eye still aches as your own and is tended with care.
tulsi_vp.271.sa: जैसो हौं तैसो राम रावरो जन, जनि परिहरिये। कृपासिंधु, कोसलधनी! सरनागत-पालक, ढरनि आपनी ढरिये॥ अपराधी तउ आपनो, तुलसी न बिसरिये। टूटियो बाँह गरे परै, फूटेहु बिलोचन पीर होत हित करिये॥

tulsi_vp.273.m: Leaving you, whom would I tell? Who else wishes me well? Friend of the lowly, who else has a natural tenderness for the servant, the friend, the suffering and the one with no one?
roles: Shows turning to the one who is tender by nature.
tulsi_vp.273.sa: तुम तजि हौं कासों कहां, और को हितु मेरे ? दीनबंधु ! सेवक, सखा, आरत, अनाथपर सहज छोह केहि केरे॥

tulsi_vp.274.m: Where do I go? Where is there a place for the hurting and poor, Lord? Who is as kind as my master, who keeps the one who comes for shelter even when every limb has lost its strength?
roles: Shows the only master who keeps the powerless.
tulsi_vp.274.sa: जाउँ कहाँ, ठौर है कहाँ देव! दुखित-दीनको ? को कृपालु स्वामी-सारिखो, राखै सरनागत सब अँग बल-बिहीनको ॥

tulsi_vp.275.m: Door to door I told my need, teeth bared, falling at feet; there are kind people in all ten directions, able to end sorrow and fault, and not one spoke to me. Seeing my sorrow, the saints said: 'Don't worry in your heart. The Lord of Raghus has not cast off even beasts, low ones and sinners like you once they took refuge, even without any other side.' Tulsi became yours and was happy, even without love or trust. The glory of the name, the Lord's gentleness: seeing my good fortune now, I am both shy and amazed.
roles: Shows he begged door to door with bared teeth.
tulsi_vp.275.sa: द्वार द्वार दीनता कही, काढ़ि रद, परि पाहूँ। हैं दयालु दुनी दस दिसा, दुख-दोष-दलन-छम, कियो न सँभाषन काहूँ॥ … दुखित देखि संतन कह्यो, सोचै जनि मन माँहू। तोसे पसु-पाँवर-पातकी परिहरे न सरन गये, रघुबर ओर बिनाहूँ॥ ३॥ तुलसी तिहारो भये भयो सुखी प्रीति-प्रतीति बिनाहू। नामकी महिमा, सील नाथको, मेरो भलो बिलोकि अब तें सकुचाहुँ, सिहाहूँ॥

tulsi_vp.30.m: Remembering him frees one from trouble and worry; his form is a treasury of joy. Tulsi says: the monkey's kind glance is a mine of every blessing.
roles: Shows his form as a store of joy.
tulsi_vp.30.sa: सुमिरत संकट-सोच-व्रिमोचन, मूरति मोद-निधानकी॥ … तुलसी कपिकी कृपा-बिलोकनि, खानि सकल कल्यानकी॥

tulsi_vp.34.m: The very distressed, the very needy, the very poor and hurting: do not take offence at them; they speak without thinking. I had reached my limit, Lord; the suffering and fear were heavy. I said what I said; forgive me, looking at it from your side.
roles: Shows him asking to be forgiven from the other's side.
tulsi_vp.34.sa: अति आरत, अति स्वारथी, अति दीन-दुखारी। इनको बिलगु न मानिये, बोलहिं न बिचारी॥ … नाकहि आये नाथसों, साँसति भय भारी। कहि आयो, कीबी छमा, निज ओर निहारी॥

tulsi_vp.35.m: In hard straits one says bitter things; a good master hears, understands, and out of his own goodness does good even to the one who wronged him.
roles: Names trust in the other's goodness after one's own lapse.
tulsi_vp.35.sa: कटु कहिये गाढे परे, सुनि समुझि सुसाई। करहिं अनभलेउ को भलो, आपनी भलाई॥

tulsi_vp.69.m: Remember with love the name of King Ram: provision for the one with none, friend of the helpless; the fortune of the unfortunate, the merit of the meritless, a buyer for the poor, the kind giver to the needy; family for the one without family, the Veda bears witness; hands and feet for the lame, eyes for the blind; mother and father for the hungry, a support for the one with no support.
roles: Shows remembering the name with love.
tulsi_vp.69.sa: सुमिरु सनेहसों तू नाम रामरायको। संबल निसंबलको, सखा असहायको॥ १॥ भाग है अभागेहूको, गुन गुनहीनको। गाहक गरीबको, दयालु दानि दीनको॥ २॥ कुल अकुलीनको, सुन्यो है बेद साखि है। पाँगुरेको हाथ-पाँय, आँधरेको आँखि है॥३॥ माय-बाप भूखेको, अधार निराधारको।

tulsi_vp.72.m: Ram did me good out of his own goodness. I have wronged my master, yet my master is good to his servant. Tulsi is as low as a blade of grass floating on the water; the water does not drown it, knowing it was the water that made it grow.
roles: Shows trusting the one who raised him.
tulsi_vp.72.sa: मेरो भलो कियो राम आपनी भलाई। हौं तो साई-द्रोही पै सेवक-हित साई॥ पाथ माथे चढ़े तृन तुलसी ज्यों नीचो। बोरत न बारि ताहि जानि आपु सींचो॥

tulsi_vp.76.m: The moment he asked, I said: 'I will be your servant; I have no one anywhere,' and I held his feet. Like a teacher he patted my back, took me by the arm and made me his own, and called me; ever the one who gives joy to servants, he carries that name.
roles: Holds the feet and offers himself.
tulsi_vp.76.sa: बूझ्यौ ज्यौ ही, कह्यो, मैं हूँ चेरो ह्वैहौ रावरो जू मेरो कोऊ कहूँ नाहि, चरन गहत हों। मींजो गुरु पीठ, अपनाइ गहि बाँह, बोलि सेबक-सुखद, सदा बिरद बहत हाौं॥

tulsi_vp.78.m: You are the one who lifts up the poor, and I am your poor one. Kind one, say it just once: "Tulsidas is mine."
roles: Gives a single sentence asked for.
tulsi_vp.78.sa: तू गरीबको निवाज, हौं गरीब तेरो। बारक कहिये कृपालु! तुलसिदास मेरो॥

tulsi_vp.79.m: You are kind and I am in need; you give and I am a beggar. I am a known wrongdoer and you lift heaps of wrong. Lord, you shelter those who have no one, and who has less than I do? No one hurts as I do, and no one heals hurt as you do. You are the infinite, I a small life; you the master, I the servant. Father and mother, teacher and friend: you wish me well in every way. There are many bonds between us; take whichever one pleases you. Only let Tulsi, somehow, find shelter at your feet.
roles: Shows somehow let Tulsi find the shelter of your feet.
tulsi_vp.79.sa: तू दयालु, दीन हौं, तू दानि, हौं भिखारी । हौं प्रसिद्ध पातकी, तू पाप-पुंज-हारी॥ नाथ तू अनाथको, अनाथ कौन मोसो। मो समान आरत नहिं, आरतिहर तोसो॥ ब्रह्म तू, हौं जीव, तू है ठाकुर, हौं चेरो। तात-मात, गुरु-सखा, तू सब बिधि हितु मेरो॥ तोहिं मोहिं नाते अनेक, मानियै जो भावै। ज्यों त्यों तुलसी कृपालु! चरन-सरन पावै॥
